_comment: Copy to $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/boss-redact.json (or point BOSS_REDACT_LIST at it) and fill in your own. These lists are what boss-event-jev.py replaces with <HOST> and <PERSON> before anything leaves the machine, so they name your fleet and your colleagues — keep the real one out of version control. `owner` is your own name: it maps to OWNER rather than <PERSON>, because the model is asked whether a step needs your own hand.
